description: Cabinetto B2B — Cloudflare WAF & edge security rules (import via dashboard or Terraform)

rules.name: Block SQL Injection Patterns
rules.description: Block SQLi in URL, query string, and request body at the edge before origin.

rules.name: Block XSS Patterns
rules.description: Block reflected/stored XSS probes at the edge.

rules.name: Bot Shield — Bulk Upload Endpoints
rules.description: Require browser verification (JS Challenge) for bulk upload and spreadsheet ingestion endpoints.

rules.name: Bot Shield — Block Obvious Script Clients on Upload APIs
rules.description: Challenge non-browser automation on sensitive upload routes.

rules.name: Geo Managed Challenge — Non-US Suspicious Traffic
rules.description: Texas-focused B2B: challenge non-US traffic with suspicious paths or auth abuse signals.
rules.expression: (ip.geoip.country ne "US") and ((http.request.uri.path matches "^/api/auth/") or (http.request.uri.path matches "^/admin") or (http.request.uri.path matches "(?i)(wp-admin|wp-login|\\.env|phpmyadmin|\\.git)"))

rules.name: Honeypot Paths — Permanent Block
rules.description: Instant block for common scanner paths that do not exist in Cabinetto.

rules.name: Rate Limit — Auth Endpoints
rules.description: Edge rate limit for login/register before origin.

notes: Apply these rules in Cloudflare Dashboard → Security → WAF → Custom rules, or via Terraform cloudflare_ruleset resource.
Set Bot Management to 'Definitely automated' action = Managed Challenge for /api/admin/* in production.
Ensure cf-connecting-ip header is forwarded to origin for Redis IP bans in Next.js proxy.
Pair with Turnstile/reCAPTCHA on /login and dealer registration forms.
